affected_subject.reason: RiskEngine.twapEMA() and its use in PanopticPool.getTWAP() are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Wrong-order destructuring of getEMAs() return values produces a concrete miscomputed formula when short-horizon price movement occurs.

direct_effect.reason: TWAP computes 60/30/10 of slow/fast/spot instead of fast/slow/eons, altering StaleOracle and solvency outcomes.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Intended vs actual formula and manipulation-resistance/stale-gate guarantee provide expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the misordered destructuring in twapEMA(), the resulting wrong formula, and its effect on liquidation/stale-oracle checks with an explicit intended-vs-actual relation.
